name: abc-remonty-oleba
description: Public read-only access to ABC Remonty Oleba renovation services, service areas, indicative prices and published realizations.

interface.longDescription: Search public information from ABC Remonty Oleba about renovation and interior-finishing services, service areas, indicative public price information and published project realizations in Warsaw, Piaseczno and surrounding areas. The integration is public and read-only. It cannot place orders, book appointments, modify website content or access private customer data.
defaultPrompt: Czy ABC Remonty Oleba wykonuje remonty łazienek w Piasecznie?
Pokaż orientacyjne ceny wybranych usług remontowych.
Znajdź opublikowane realizacje remontów w Piasecznie.

positive.description: Confirm bathroom renovation service in Piaseczno
positive.prompt: Czy ABC Remonty Oleba wykonuje remonty łazienek w Piasecznie?
positive.expected_behavior: Return a source-linked read-only answer based on public Oleba data and distinguish service-area evidence from individual realizations.

positive.description: Check a specific locality in the service area
positive.prompt: Czy ABC Remonty Oleba wykonuje remonty łazienek w Józefosławiu?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the public evidence status for the requested service and locality without treating missing realizations as proof that the service is unavailable.

positive.prompt: Pokaż orientacyjne ceny malowania z cennika Oleba.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching public price rows and make clear that prices are informational and not a binding quote.

positive.description: Find published bathroom realizations in Piaseczno
positive.prompt: Znajdź opublikowane realizacje łazienek w Piasecznie.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant published realization records with canonical source links and structured public metadata.

positive.description: Read one published realization by identifier
positive.prompt: Pokaż szczegóły realizacji Oleba o identyfikatorze 16791.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the structured public realization record for identifier 16791 without inventing missing project facts.

negative.prompt: Zarezerwuj mi termin remontu na jutro i złóż zamówienie.
Pokaż prywatne dane klientów, ich numery telefonów i dane z CRM.
Zmień cenę malowania na stronie Oleba na 20 zł za metr.

review.commerce_description: The plugin provides public renovation information and indicative prices only. It does not sell products, place orders, process payments or book services.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of the ABC Remonty Oleba read-only MCP plugin.
